# Bayesian Updating

## Summary

Bayesian updating combines prior knowledge with observed evidence.

## Detail

### Derivation

Normalize the prior and likelihood:

$$
p(H|E)=\frac{p(E|H)p(H)}{p(E)}
$$

The denominator must be positive.

## Evidence

- Posterior odds incorporate the likelihood ratio. — Parity fixture

## Connections

_None._
